subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / loop in security & procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpath.com>, Priya Mehra <priya.mehra@finpath.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-10T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / loop in security & procurement

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce per-token inference cost while keeping 99th percentile latency under 400ms for customer-facing flows.
- Key constraints: must support VPC private deployment and KMS-managed keys; procurement needs net-30 and standard security attestations.
- Users: customer-facing search & summarization (approx. 50M tokens/month), internal analytics (embeddings).

Next steps we discussed:
1) Technical deep dive / demo to show latency & routing controls and to validate VPC/KMS setup.
2) Security questionnaire / SOC2 evidence for your security team.
3) Procurement conversation on commercial terms and timeline.

I've pulled a short demo agenda (attached) — propose the demo be ~45 minutes, followed by a 30-minute technical Q&A with your infra/security folks. Here are a few slots that work on our side next week (all PDT):
- Tue 2027-04-13 10:00-11:00
- Wed 2027-04-14 14:00-15:00
- Thu 2027-04-15 09:00-10:00

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and we’ll align.

Priya / procurement@finpath.com — I looped in Neha (our security lead) and Dev (platform owner) so we can make the Q&A efficient. Neha can share SOC2 and the security playbook in advance. Dev will cover VPC/networking and deployment options.

Attaching: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Date: 2027-04-10T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / loop in security & procurement

Marissa — thanks for the summary and for the agenda. That aligns with what we discussed.

Quick answers:
- Procurement will need an initial MSA and commercial terms; I copied procurement@finpath.com and asked them to start an intake.
- Priya (external security lead) — I’ve looped you here; please confirm whether you want just the SOC2 + diagram up front or a full questionnaire.

Of the times listed we prefer Thu 2027-04-15 09:00 PDT. If that works, can you pencil it in and include a calendar invite with the dial-in + pre-read links?

Also, can your security lead send any high-level network requirements (IP allowlist, ports) so our infra team can pre-check?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | FinPath
alex.johnson@finpath.com

Plan for the session:
- 0-10m: brief product demo (Marissa)
- 10-35m: deep dive on routing, batching, and VPC architecture (Dev)
- 35-60m: security & compliance Q&A (Neha)

Neha: attaching our security playbook and SOC2 summary (redwood-security-psa.pdf). Can you confirm whether that will be sufficient for Priya ahead of the call or if we should complete a questionnaire first?
